whenToUse: Processing continues after sending, as with inquiries, applications, and orders.
There's information people will need later, such as a reference number or expected time.
You need to say what to do after sending.
whenNotToUse: A short result is enough, as when saving settings (use a toast).
People need to keep working on the same screen.
Sending failed (use an error summary or alert banner).

alternatives.name: Toast
alternatives.reason: Briefly reporting a result without changing the screen.

alternatives.name: Error Summary
alternatives.reason: Sending failed and there are fields to fix.

accessibility: When the form disappears, move focus to the result heading so keyboard and screen reader users don't lose their place.
Write the heading as a sentence about what happened ("Your inquiry was sent").
The check icon is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
Pressing the next action (write another inquiry) returns focus to the input.
